# Lyfe task manager

Lyfe is Sebastian (Sebo) and Alomi's task manager.

Machine-readable integration metadata:
https://ssiatkowski.github.io/lyfe/lyfe-ai.json

Public read-only task API:
https://us-west2-lyfe-cacf7.cloudfunctions.net/taskReadApi

Usage:
- For Sebastian/Sebo, GET taskReadApi?owner=Sebo
- For Alomi, GET taskReadApi?owner=Alomi
- Add &through=YYYY-MM-DD to include tasks due through a future date.
- Shared tasks owned by All are included automatically.
- If the user's identity is unclear, ask whether they are Sebo or Alomi before fetching.
- For catch-up planning, normally make one request through today and reason from dueDate, status, daysOverdue, frequency, and type.
- Do not repeatedly refetch the same task list unless the user asks for a refresh.

The public reader has no write routes and exposes only task-planning fields. Add/modify use a separate private API; delete is not available through the API.
